title: Evidence lives only in attestations
statement: A proof run MUST be kept as an attestation at the CI provider with the commit as its subject, and MUST NOT be committed as a file, since a file for one commit can only land in the next.

title: A result folder is written once
statement: A build, download or image run MUST create its output folder with an exclusive create, MUST refuse a folder that exists, and MUST remove the folder when the run fails before its record is written, so a result is never overwritten and a retry starts from nothing.

title: Delivery state lives in git and the attestation
statement: The delivery objects MUST be kept in the project folder under git, the check outcome MUST be kept as an attestation on the image, and STEGO MUST keep no delivery store of its own.

title: The record and the generated files are saved whole or not at all
statement: Apply MUST write the generated files and the new record as one journaled transaction in the project folder and save the record last, so a crash leaves the old record with the old files or the new record with the new, and the next run completes or rolls back the journal before anything else.

title: The registry is read at one pinned content and never written
statement: A run MUST read the registry sources at the pinned reference and MUST NOT write to them, and the content digest the record keeps MUST equal the digest of what was read.
